observations: Industrial-style standing fan with a round wire safety cage guard
Three wood-brown colored plastic blades visible from front in all four photos
Gold/brass colored motor hub with a small red circular badge/logo that is not legible in any photo
Black metal pole stand and black four-spoke heavy base (tripod/round base)
No power cord, plug, or speed control switch visible in any shot
No box, receipt, or packaging shown alongside the fan
Background shows a tiled floor, a cardboard carton, and what looks like a refrigerator/cabinet
All four photos are near-duplicate close-ups of the same fan from slightly different angles, no wide shot, no powered-on/spinning shot

claims.evidence: No receipt, box, or purchase proof shown in any photo
No photo or clip shows the fan plugged in, spinning, or oscillating; no power cord even visible

risks.risk: Motor may not run or may be weak/noisy
risks.proof: Short video clip of fan plugged in and running at each speed

risks.risk: Speed control switch/regulator condition unknown, not visible in photos
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the switch/control box and cord

risks.risk: Blade balance or wobble when spinning cannot be assessed from static photos
risks.proof: Video of fan running showing blade rotation steadily

risks.risk: Cage or blades may have hidden cracks/rust not visible in current angles
risks.proof: Close-up photos of blade edges and cage joints, plus a shot of the base underside
risks.if_unproven: priced as used with cosmetic risk

risks.risk: Claim of 'brand new' cannot be confirmed; item could be used/refurbished
risks.proof: Photo of original box, receipt, or warranty card

proof_requests: A video clip of the fan plugged in, running, and oscillating at each speed
A clear photo of the power cord, plug, and speed switch
A close-up photo of the brand/logo badge on the hub, in focus
A photo of the original box or purchase receipt if claiming brand new
Photos of blade tips and cage for any cracks, rust, or repairs
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable by type as an industrial standing fan, but with no powered-on evidence the 'working perfectly' and 'brand new' claims are unverified, so it must be priced at worst case (as not working, as used) until a running video or purchase proof is supplied.
